input.quote: Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of the Fees paid or payable by Customer during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and USD 1,000,000. The cap is mutual and applies regardless of the form of action or number of claims.
input.rationale: Section 21 matches our preferred position: a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' Fees (paid or payable) and USD 1,000,000, a mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages with restoration and incident-response costs treated as direct damages, and Excluded Claims in 21.3 covering confidentiality, data protection, security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement. "Fees" (1.5) is the full recurring/professional/usage fee stream, so the cap is not illusory, and Customer's payment obligation is expressly not "damages". No redline needed; note that the Excluded Claims reference to "indemnification obligations" only has effect once the missing indemnity (INDEMN) is added.

input.quote: Customer may terminate an Order Form immediately if Vendor suffers a material Security Incident, repeatedly misses a critical service level, violates Applicable Law in performing the Services, or infringes a third party's intellectual property and cannot provide the remedies required by Section 20.5.
input.rationale: There is no indemnification section at all: the outline jumps from Section 19 (Warranties) to Section 21 (Limitation of Liability), yet Sections 9.3, 19.4, 21.3 and 30.5 all assume indemnities exist and 9.3 cross-references a non-existent Section 20.5. We inserted a new Section 20 with a Vendor IP/breach-of-law/data-incident/wilful-misconduct indemnity, a narrow Customer indemnity limited to Customer-provided content and its breach of law, standard notice/control/cooperation procedure, and the procure-modify-replace-refund remedies (which also repairs the 9.3 cross-reference).
